title: "Show in FileSystem" is inconsistent
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in `4.8.dev` [4173760], `4.7.stable`.

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Mentioned in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119638.
Related: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119594, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/84882.

Currently, "Show in FileSystem" behaves in 4 ways:
1. When a non-root scene instance node is selected, it highlights the "original" scene.
2. When a root node is selected in a normal scene, it highlights the "current" scene.
3. When a root node is selected in an inherited scene, it highlights the "current" scene (same as 2).
4. When a root node is selected in a new, unsaved inherited scene, it is not available.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c63ac40-9e1d-4e35-86e4-90ed2f8acec7

Expected behaviour:
(1) and (2) are expected behaviours, based on the discussion below.
(3) should have two buttons, "Show in FileSystem (current scene)" and "Show in FileSystem (source scene)".
(4) should have one button, "Show in FileSystem (source scene)".

I can open a PR if needed.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Right-click on any scene root.
2. "Show in FileSystem" is available for any scene root. Clicking it highlights the current scene.
3. "Show in FileSystem" is unavailable for a new, unsaved inherited scene root.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_Show_In_FileSystem.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30862885/MRP_Show_In_FileSystem.zip)
